I am writing to express my strong interest in the Bioinformatician I position at the Institute for Genomic Health at Mount Sinai. With a background in research and over six years of experience in data science and technical problem-solving, I have developed a strong foundation in analyzing genomic data, managing databases, and optimizing analysis workflows.

My conceptual understanding of scientific methods, combined with technical expertise in R and database systems, allows me to effectively manage and analyze large-scale datasets. I am skilled in identifying technical issues, and I have a proven track record of collaborating with researchers to identify disease-related information and ensure rigorous attention to detail.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of my interest in biomedical data science and the application of machine learning to healthcare. I am adaptable, eager to contribute to the analysis of electronic health records, and dedicated to the mission of bridging the gap between genomic research and patient care.

You can find my portfolio and publications at www.lmgb.xyz. Thank you for your consideration.
